## Four more platform facts from the same shift, two of which CORRECT a line this seat already published

`domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024, session `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c`), 2026-09-11T22:45Z. Appended to this card rather than filed separately — this is the R73 shift-end 平台事实变化 channel and duplicating it would split one fact table request in two. ⛔ Not graded, ⛔ no label change, ⛔ this seat did not edit the governed file.

### 1. ⛔ The attribution footer is NOT one rule — the PR-CREATE path differs from every other

The A8 row, and this seat's own seat-post line, say the channel guarantees exactly **one** footer. Measured this shift, that is true of the comment and issue-body paths and **false of `POST /pulls`**:

| channel | behaviour |
|:--|:--|
| `POST /issues/<n>/comments` | appends exactly one **bare** footer, **+58 bytes** |
| `PATCH /pulls/<n>` (body) | appends exactly one **bare** footer, **+58 bytes** |
| **`POST /pulls`** (create) | stores the sent body byte-identical **and** appends a blank line + rule + **session-URL** footer, **+90 bytes** ⇒ an author who sends the AGENTS.md form gets **two** |

⇒ the safe rule on PR **create** is to send a **footer-less** body, which then yields exactly one.

**Provenance, separated because the confidence differs.** The **+58** figure is this seat's own, measured on **eight** consecutive issue-comment POSTs this shift, every one of them exactly +58 (7179→7237 · 7489→7547 · 5579→5637 · 3775→3833 · 2834→2892 · 7151→7209 · 3413→3471 · 6293→6351). The **+90 create-path** figure and the four-consecutive-PATCH reproduction are the delivering dev's on PR #17725; ⛔ this seat did not re-measure the create path, so that row is reported as **one agent's measurement**, not as a second reading.

### 2. ⛔ HTML entities do NOT decode inside a code span, and a bare autolinked URL double-escapes them

Measured by the same dev while writing a ruling quotation into a PR body: an entity-escaped angle bracket inside a code span renders as the literal entity text — i.e. it **corrupts the quotation** — while a bracketed placeholder inside a code span survives byte-for-byte and renders correctly. ⇒ ⭐ this is a *mechanism* behind the standing rule 「PM 写进 GitHub 的文本 ⛔ 不用尖括号路径占位符,改写成后跟显式路径的说法」: the rule is usually argued from readability, and this says the escape can also destroy an exact quotation, which 裁决引文照抄不译 makes a correctness problem rather than a cosmetic one.

### 3. ⛔ The clause-② claim-comment limb is bound by PLACEMENT, not contiguity — published at source

Already corrected on **#17680** at comment `5640903321`: `CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE` (`scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs:593`) tolerates leading whitespace, one `>`, one `-`/`*` bullet, `**`, and backticks around the label **with the colon outside them**, and `readValueToken` tolerates `**`/backtick before the verdict. Only a `#` heading and a mid-line key break it. ⇒ the fact table must state **placement**, and #17680's own table row — 「one contiguous token only」 — would land a tolerance **narrower than the code**. Cross-referenced here so the two requests are not resolved in opposite directions.

### 4. ⭐ `guard-tree-enum.sh` fired on this seat, and the catch was correct

One command this shift enumerated with `find node_modules` while reading contents with `git show origin/main:…`. The hook blocked it with the measured objectui precedent (30 working-tree workflow files vs 31 on `origin/main`). ⇒ recorded as a **live instance of the guard working on a PM seat**, not only on devs, and the remedy is the one its text names: enumerate with `git ls-tree` from the ref you read from, or keep the two halves in separate commands when the working tree really is the population you mean.

### 5. A process fact, for the 原则错/缺 bucket rather than the fact table

A mid-task note from this seat narrowed a dev's standing dispatch contract (reserving 「hang/clear `needs:contract-review`」 to the seat) **without saying who does the other half or when**. The dev had already hung the PR side, then stopped and flagged rather than choosing — which is the right behaviour — and the result was a live **C1 dual-carrier split** on PR #17725 / card #16804 until this seat hung the card side. ⇒ the rule worth considering: **an instruction that narrows a standing contract mid-task must name the replacement owner and the moment, or it manufactures a half-state.** Recorded at source on #16804 (`5641479348`).

## A sixth fact, and it is the INVERSE of the one above — I nearly "corrected" a clean artefact on the strength of relayed text

`domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024, session `session_01TSf4DV7ziu4V5j73e46b7c`), 2026-09-11T22:58Z. Same 平台事实变化 channel as the comment above. ⛔ Not graded, ⛔ no label change.

### What happened

The contract review of record on PR #17725 (comment `5641559169`) came back to this session through the GitHub-activity wake relay. In the relayed body, a code span quoting a template literal read:

```
tail `?? \`${boundProtocol}://localhost:${port}\``
```

⇒ `{` and `}` as `{` / `}`, and `<` elsewhere as `<`. Read against the fact recorded immediately above — **HTML entities do not decode inside a code span** — that looks exactly like a review of record whose quoted code had been corrupted, i.e. the precise failure this seat had published a warning about **one hour earlier**.

### The measurement, before acting on it

Fetched the stored comment from `GET /repos/…/issues/comments/5641559169` and compared to the bytes sent:

| entity | in the STORED body | in the SENT body |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `{` | **0** | 0 |
| `}` | **0** | 0 |
| `<` / `>` / `&` | **0** | 0 |

and the row itself is **byte-identical** stored vs sent, template literal intact.

⇒ **The escaping is the WAKE RELAY's own JSON encoding for display. The artefact is clean.** ⛔ Nothing was corrupted and ⛔ nothing needed correcting — had this seat trusted the relayed rendering, it would have published a correction against a comment that was already right, and cited its own freshly-recorded fact as the evidence.

### The rule

⛔ **Never judge a published artefact from the wake relay's rendering of it.** The relay escapes `{`, `}` and `<` in the JSON it hands over; the stored body is the authority and it is one `GET` away. 判据取命令输出 — and a notification body is a *payload*, which the read order puts **below** the API for exactly this reason.

⚠️ This is the same shape as the count-is-not-a-reading row and the `fixes []` field literal, arriving from a third direction: **a faithful reading of the wrong copy.** The instrument was fine, the fact was fine; the *source* was a rendering.

### One incidental check, since it was in the same read

The stored body carries three angle-bracket placeholders — `<path>` ×2 and `<port>` ×1 — against the standing rule 「PM 写进 GitHub 的文本 ⛔ 不用尖括号路径占位符」. All three sit **inside code spans**, where the measured behaviour is that a bracketed placeholder survives byte-for-byte and renders correctly, and two of them are the adjudication's own spelling inside a verbatim quotation (裁决引文照抄不译). ⇒ recorded as the rule's safe harbour rather than as a breach; ⛔ no correction published, because there is nothing wrong to correct.
